title: GE - LS (Life Sciences)
description: A general education course in the life sciences, such as biology, ecology, or human biology.
notes: Utah general education attribute or designation.

title: WR1 - Writing Requirement 1
description: A first-year writing course on college-level reading, argument, and composition.
notes: Utah general education attribute or designation. WR1 is the first writing requirement.

title: GE - BF (Social/Behavioral Science Expl)
description: A general education course in the social or behavioral sciences, such as psychology, sociology, economics, or anthropology.
notes: Utah general education attribute or designation.

title: GE - AI (American Institutions)
description: A general education course on American institutions: United States history, government, or economics, often required by state law.
notes: Utah general education attribute or designation.

title: PS - Physical Sciences
description: A general education course in the physical sciences, such as physics, chemistry, geology, or astronomy.
notes: Utah general education attribute or designation.

title: BD - DV (Diversity)
description: A general education course on diversity in society: race, ethnicity, gender, culture, or identity.
notes: Utah general education attribute or designation.

title: HF - Humanities Exploration
description: A general education course in the humanities, such as literature, philosophy, history, or languages.
notes: Utah general education attribute or designation.

title: CS 4150 or CS 4400 (Algorithms)
description: An upper-level core computer science course: either algorithms (design and analysis, graph algorithms, dynamic programming) or computer systems from a programmer's view (machine-level programs, memory hierarchy, linking, concurrency).
notes: Utah: CS 4150 and CS 4400 are both required, one in each Year 3 term. Official descriptions are in the saved courses data.

title: CS Elective
description: An upper-level computer science course chosen by the student.

title: GE - FF (Fine Art Exploration)
description: A general education course in the fine arts, such as art, music, theatre, dance, or film.
notes: Utah general education attribute or designation.

title: BD - IR (International Requirement)
description: A general education course on international or global topics outside the United States.
notes: Utah general education attribute or designation.

title: CS 3100 or CS 3200 (Models of Computation)
description: An upper-level CS theory or computation course: models of computation (automata, Turing machines, computability) or scientific and data computing.
notes: Choice slot: Utah's CS 3100 or CS 3200.

title: WRTG 3014 or WRTG 3015 (Writing in the Sciences)
description: An upper-division writing course: scientific writing, or professional writing for organizations.
notes: Choice slot: Utah's WRTG 3014 or WRTG 3015.

title: General Elective
description: Any course the student chooses that counts toward the degree, inside or outside the major.

title: CS 4000 or CS 4940 (Senior Capstone Project - Design Phase)
description: The first semester of a senior capstone: a team software project's design phase, or undergraduate research with a faculty member.
notes: Choice slot: Utah's CS 4000 or CS 4940.

title: Additional Math/Science
description: An additional mathematics, science, or engineering course building on calculus.
notes: Utah: one course with MATH 1220 as a pre- or co-requisite.

title: CS 4500 or CS 4970 (Senior Capstone Project)
description: The second semester of the senior capstone: the team software project, or a bachelor's thesis.
notes: Choice slot: Utah's CS 4500 or CS 4970.
